collaborations.name: NEURO-EMERGE AFRICA
collaborations.partner: FAMSA Health Systems Strengthening Technical Working Group (HSS TWG)
collaborations.summary: A joint youth platform with FAMSA's Health Systems Strengthening Technical Working Group, focused on youth-driven solutions for emergency and neurotrauma care in Africa.
collaborations.body:
NEURO-EMERGE AFRICA was set up under the FAMSA Health Systems Strengthening Technical Working Group to build a lasting Pan-African community of young people who can contribute to emergency and neurotrauma care.

The Glial Initiative supported the platform through its foundation phase. Our identity appeared across the inaugural programme's publicity, and our leadership and networks helped bring a multidisciplinary group of speakers and experts into the programme.

The inaugural Youth Co-Creation Webinar, "Saving Brains by Strengthening Systems: Youth Co-Creating Solutions for Emergency and Neurotrauma Care in Africa", brought young people together with professionals working on pre-hospital care, triage and referral, financing, injury data, prevention, digital innovation and policy.

The partnership is built around a community, not a single event. The next phase connects members to training and opportunities, strengthens research and evidence generation, and supports practical initiatives for stronger emergency and neurotrauma systems across Africa.

collaborations.name: Lucid
collaborations.summary: A partnership with the Lucid team to adapt and pilot their phone-based AI head-injury triage tool for the Nigerian context.
collaborations.body:
Lucid is a phone-based, AI-assisted tool that helps triage head injuries. We are working with the Lucid team to adapt the technology for the Nigerian context and to plan a pilot.

The collaboration supports our Innovation & Digital Health pillar: scalable, low-cost technology that helps people recognise serious head injuries early and seek care.
